analysis.name: Test a conversion leak
analysis.finding: Routine collection: 26,099 sessions, 0.92% purchase rate vs 2.85% on Mask product.

data.title: Routine collection clarity / landing variants
data.hypothesis: The collection page may leave visitors unsure which product to choose. Channel mix and page intent differ, so compare randomly assigned variants on the same page.
data.variants: Control: current collection. A: one concise use-case headline, product comparison and visible price. B: routine checklist, product grid and transparent delivery / returns summary. Primary metric: purchase conversion; guardrails: AOV and checkout abandonment. No uplift promised.

data.title: Variant A — Pick your evening starting point
data.body: Headline: Find one simple place to begin your wind-down. Show journal, mask and kit with clear price, contents and comparison. Keep reviews and policies factual; no medical claims.

data.title: Variant B — Build a three-step evening ritual
data.body: Headline: Phone away. Plan tomorrow. Settle your space. Present the checklist, then optional product grid with clear prices and delivery information. Avoid guaranteed sleep outcomes.

data.title: Specify randomization, sample requirement and conversion guardrails
Review test readiness before any real storefront change
